verdict.rationale: Obsidian's own docs say Obsidian Sync supports collaborating on a shared vault with a team (obsidian-docs-11), and version history lets users view or restore earlier note versions (obsidian-docs-28), so the core of sharing a vault is first-party. Nothing documents conflict handling or simultaneous editing, and a community comment says Google-Docs-style real-time collaboration came from a separately built CRDT plugin (obsidian-comm-8). That suggests concurrent editing without overwrites is not native. Missing for 10: documented conflict resolution or merge behavior, real-time co-editing, collaborator permissions, independent hands-on corroboration of shared-vault collaboration.
